# black-clean paths — the BLOCKING half of the `backend-lint` CI job (issue #49).
#
# Why an allowlist instead of `black --check app/ tests/ scripts/`:
# at main c630436, 603 of 619 Python files under app/ tests/ scripts/ would be
# reformatted. A repo-wide blocking check is therefore impossible without a
# ~600-file reformat commit, which #49 explicitly puts out of scope ("Do not fix
# whatever the audits report"). A repo-wide `continue-on-error` check alone would
# be pure noise that nobody ever reads.
#
# So the lint job runs two steps:
#   1. BLOCKING  — `black --check` over exactly the files listed below.
#   2. REPORTING — `black --check` over the whole tree, continue-on-error, so the
#                  drift count stays visible and shrinks measurably.
#
# This file is a RATCHET. It only ever grows:
#   * Reformatted a file? Add it here in the same commit.
#   * Added a new .py file? It should be black-clean, so add it here.
#   * Never remove an entry to make CI pass — reformat the file instead.
#
# `tests/test_ci_gates.py::test_black_allowlist_entries_are_actually_clean`
# verifies every entry here is genuinely black-clean, so a dirty path cannot be
# added without the test suite catching it first.
#
# Baseline recorded 2026-08-25 at main c630436: 16 clean / 619 total.
#
# HONEST SIZE OF THE GATE. Do not read "16 files" as "16 files of code":
# 10 of the 16 entries are 0-byte `__init__.py` files (measured with `wc -c`),
# which are black-clean vacuously. The gate therefore covers SIX substantive
# files, five of them pre-existing plus tests/test_ci_gates.py which #49 wrote.
# That is ~1% of the tree: a change to app/services/price_service.py still
# passes lint untouched. The issue's "PRs are gated on formatting" is NOT yet
# achieved — this is a ratchet pointed the right way, not the finished gate.
# The whole-tree drift report in ci.yml keeps the remaining ~603 visible.

app/__init__.py
app/api/__init__.py
app/core/__init__.py
app/models/__init__.py
app/services/__init__.py
app/services/prompt_personalities.py
app/utils/__init__.py
scripts/__init__.py
tests/__init__.py
tests/fixtures/lane1/__init__.py
tests/perf/__init__.py
tests/test_ci_gates.py
tests/test_fan_out_budget_env.py
tests/test_parallel_race_escalation.py
tests/test_price_consolidation.py
tests/test_registry_ounass_bh_l12.py
